falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5650 on any daily session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom featured a 12% drawdown with no immediate V-recovery to prior highs; a breakout to new highs this fast would signal a shallow correction/bull continuation, not a structural bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 implies elevated volatility/uncertainty; sustained VIX sub-14 would indicate fear has fully collapsed and the market has returned to complacency, contradicting the bottoming process thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 5+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A bottom_2024_aug analog requires rates stabilizing or rising in a growth-scare context; a sustained plunge to flight-to-safety levels would indicate recession panic rather than a soft-landing bottom, breaking the pattern's macro premise

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
